anti_drift: The target is BALANCED: ~391 unlabeled real lenses : ~391 fresh P2 negatives, ~1:1, per fold. The 1:2200 rarity applies only at evaluation. This has been miscorrected repeatedly.
Two morphology instruments, ~0.34 apart. Never quote one as the other; a monitor built on the frozen probe cannot see a failure that only moved the head.
Compute the interval before writing the sentence, and always run the known-null -- in this project the known-null has changed the conclusion more often than the main analysis has.

alternative_considered_and_declined.alternative: read this arm at EACH DA arm's own budget (1500 / 2000 / 4000), which is the coherent choice if its primary role were 'method-neutral baseline for all three DA arms' rather than 'DANN's control'
alternative_considered_and_declined.declined_because: 7.18 treats the lambda contrast as this arm's most striking claim, and no single budget serves the method-neutral role. Recorded so a reader sees the choice was made, not assumed.
alternative_considered_and_declined.partially_recovered_by: the pre-declared sensitivity readouts at 1500 and 2000 below, which give the budget-matched comparators for free

budget.rule: THE CONTROL IS READ WHERE ITS TREATMENT IS READ. Budget = 4000, DANN x nb3's declared budget.
budget.what_this_rule_does_NOT_claim: It does not claim 4000 is optimal for this arm. It almost certainly is not -- fold 0 peaks at 250. 'Optimal' was never available (7.13). This is a DECLARED CHOICE WITH A STATED BASIS, as 7.14 requires of every per-method budget, not a derived optimum.
budget.why_no_rule_from_this_arm_s_own_configur: This arm has NOTHING with a horizon: no lambda ramp, no EMA, no thresholds, no mu, no scheduler. The rule that produced FreeMatch's 1500 (SAT saturation), CORAL's 2000 (gamma config with EMA disabled) and DANN's 4000 (2x the lambda horizon) has nothing to grab onto.
budget.why_not_from_the_fold0_curve: It peaks at step 250 and degrades, with the highest checkpoint scatter of any arm (sd/mean 0.276, absolute sd 0.0402). Declaring a budget from where that curve looks best is the winner's curse 7.11 forbids, and 7.13 established peak location is unmeasurable at ~98 positives regardless.
budget.why_this_rule: Arms 1 and 2 share an initialisation, a fold, a seed, a GPU and a step grid and differ in lambda alone -- the only fully controlled cross-arm contrast in the project. Reading the control at a different step than its treatment introduces a second difference and destroys the one clean contrast available. The rule states in one sentence, reads no metric, and is hashable in advance.

THREE_CONDITIONS_FIRE_IMMEDIATELY_ON_A_H.3b_head_column: morph_head_auroc_pool is 0.5657 at the true step 0 but 0.4356 at the first logged training step, so the < 0.5 detector fires at step 1 on a run with NO adversary at all. Longest streak 375.
THREE_CONDITIONS_FIRE_IMMEDIATELY_ON_A_H.4_rank_collapse: participation ratio ranges 2.03-9.69 across all 8000 steps of arm 1, entirely below the declared threshold of 20 of 640. The condition fires on 100% of a healthy control's steps and has never had discriminative power in this pipeline.
THREE_CONDITIONS_FIRE_IMMEDIATELY_ON_A_H.consequence: Both are recorded as EXPECTED FIRINGS. A firing here is a property of the threshold, not evidence about the run, and it must not be reported as a finding about folds 1-4. Neither can stop anything: the arm is log_only on every fold.
THREE_CONDITIONS_FIRE_IMMEDIATELY_ON_A_H.the_one_that_is_actually_informative: 3b on the PROBE column (morph_proxy_auroc < 0.7) does NOT fire: 0.9202 at step 0, 0.9172 at step 1, longest streak 0 over 8000 steps. It is the only member of this family with headroom, and it is the one to watch.

STEP_0_EVALUATION.rule: Evaluate every declared threshold at step 0 BEFORE declaring it, and print the step-0 value into the pre-registration. Earned twice: round 5's abort3b, and round 6 Stage 0a's 0.25-0.75 collapse band, which would have fired at step 0 on the initialisation's own 0.2292 predicted-positive fraction.

conditions.arming: ADVISORY, NEVER ABORTING, on every fold.
derived_from_control_arm: condition 3a's margin M (UNSET, and 7.19 declared 3a UNCALIBRABLE: 3J = 0.099 against a ceiling of 0.04)
conditions.derived_from_control_arm_note: These are labelled derived_from_control_arm and are NOT pre-registration. 3a is additionally INAPPLICABLE here: this arm IS the control, so the condition would compare it against itself.
conditions.mechanism: run_dann_r5.default_abort_mode returns log_only for EVERY fold of a lambda_zero arm -- verified on the emitted configs for folds 1-4. No flag is needed and none is passed.
conditions.why: Round 5's abort3b fired on all four confirmatory folds and under the pre-registered arrangement would have killed every one at ~step 450. v10's decision to make conditions 3 and 4 advisory is what preserved that data.

no_new_code: No new loss and no new code path. run_dann_r5.py --arm dann_nb3_lambda0 --fold k --max-steps 4000, k in {1,2,3,4}.

reporting.DISCLOSURE_that_travels_with_the_bottom_: This arm initialises from Baseline A's head, as DANN x nb3 does. CORAL x nb3 initialises from round-1 CORAL heads and FreeMatch x nb3 from its own. So it is a legitimate METHOD-NEUTRAL baseline for those two but NOT a matched control for them. Only the DANN row is a matched contrast. State this in the SAME SENTENCE as the numbers, not in a footnote.
reporting.SECOND_DISCLOSURE_found_by_the_audit: DANN's confirmatory folds ran with abort_mode='armed' while this arm runs 'log_only' on every fold. An armed detector either aborts or does nothing, and DANN's folds did not abort, so this cannot have changed a training step -- but it is a real asymmetry in the 'only fully controlled contrast' and is disclosed rather than smoothed over.
reporting.interval: paired t-interval on 4 differences, df=3. NOT a bootstrap: at n=4 a bootstrap draws from 4^4=256 distinct resamples and its tails are a lattice artifact.

paired_contrasts.isolates: the adversarial term alone -- the only fully controlled contrast

reporting.pooling: INVALID for per-fold-model arms. Per-fold ROC curves only.
reporting.primary_metric: TPR@FPR=1e-3, interpolated, drop_intermediate=False, ALWAYS a rate, never counts
reporting.round1: No number here is differenced against any round-1 number.
reporting.stability_table: Compute this arm's checkpoint-to-checkpoint sd on folds 1-4 and add it to 7.18's table alongside fold 0's sd/mean 0.276. If unfreezing without a DA term is the noisiest arm on four more folds, that becomes a claim rather than a single-fold observation.
reporting.undefined_values: report as n/a with NO CI. Never a reachability-conditional bootstrap, never an aggregate fabricated from the reachable subset.

revision_rule: NOTHING here may be revised after any confirmatory fold runs. Anything re-specified from a control arm is labelled derived_from_control_arm and is NOT pre-registration.

run.collection_defect_to_avoid: Round 5's per-checkpoint logits never came home (7.18). CONFIRM the logit files are present and complete BEFORE the Kaggle session ends.
run.confirm_budget_rule_field_is_round5s: run_config.json's confirm_budget_rule / budget_status fields carry round 5's DANN wording ('2 x the lambda horizon'), a provenance artifact of reusing the runner unmodified. THIS FILE is authoritative for round 6's rule.
run.cost: ~153 min/fold on T4, ~10.2 GPU-h total, two Kaggle sessions
run.on_declared_steps_will_read_false: ARMS['dann_nb3_lambda0']['steps'] is round 5's development maximum of 8000, so passing --max-steps 4000 makes run_config record on_declared_steps=false. That is CORRECT and means 'not on round 5's development maximum'. 4000 is ROUND 6's declared confirmatory budget and this file is its authority. run_dann_r5.py is deliberately NOT edited to say so, because editing it would break the byte-match against DANN's confirmatory folds -- which is the match that matters.
run.record_gpu_architecture_for_every_fold: results are not portable across GPU architectures at this precision (7.7)

components.ckpt_log_cadence: ckpt_every 250 / log_every 125 -> 16 checkpoints; steps (1500, 2000) are checkpoints [6, 8]
components.epochs_planned: ceil(max_steps / steps_per_epoch), used only to cap the loop; data order comes from the sampler, so steps 0..N see identical batches at any max_steps
components.gradient_clipping: none -- 0 hits, matching 7.14's no-clip CORAL fix
components.gradscaler_growth_interval: not set anywhere; torch's default 2000 applies, an ABSOLUTE step count whose state at step N depends only on steps 0..N
components.lambda_horizon: dann_lambda_at_step reads lambda_horizon only, never total_steps -- and on THIS arm lambda is pinned to 0.0 at every step, so the schedule cannot matter here at all
components.lr_decay: layer-wise, indexing DEPTH (backbone_lr * lr_decay**i over blocks)
components.param_groups_mutation: no assignment targets param_groups -- lr/wd/betas set once at construction
components.sampler_num_batches: derived from len(src_ds) // batch_size, not from max_steps
components.torch_lr_scheduler: none exists in any audited module
components.total_steps: the coral-hook branch this arm takes contains 0 occurrences (9 statements scanned); train_step only FORWARDS it through 2 early-return guards into the AdaMatch/FreeMatch branches

script_provenance.da_losses_py: differs from every run because round 6 appended BNM to it. PROVEN append-only: sha256 of lines 1-1441 of the current file equals 6b05cd66dd7ad345, the whole-file hash every DANN run recorded. Every byte those runs executed is bit-identical.
script_provenance.finding: THREE versions of run_dann_r5.py exist in the record -- arm 1 fold 0 (9b6e38669c), arm 2 fold 0 (4fd5964f37), and DANN folds 1-4 (320ed27d74, which is also the working tree). 7.19's re-specification of conditions 3 and 4 landed between them.
script_provenance.what_is_therefore_NOT_matched: Arm 1's fold-0 bytes. Byte-matching both is impossible. CONSEQUENCE, declared here rather than discovered later: under 7.15's rule, fold 0's 0.1531 is a QUALITATIVE consistency check against the folds-1-4 mean and is NEVER differenced against it. Fold 0 is development and enters no mean anyway.
script_provenance.what_these_folds_match: DANN's confirmatory folds 1-4, BYTE-FOR-BYTE on run_dann_r5.py, dann_round5.py and train_skeleton.py. That is the match the science needs, because DANN x nb3 - lambda=0 on folds 1-4 is the only fully controlled contrast.

sensitivity_readouts.clause: Reported ALONGSIDE the headline; they do NOT replace it, whichever is higher. 7.18's clause, verbatim.
sensitivity_readouts.free: ckpt_every is 250 and the budget is 4000, so 1500 and 2000 are checkpoints 6 and 8 of 16 on every fold. No extra compute.
sensitivity_readouts.if_a_component_carries_a_horizon: DROP the sensitivity readouts and say they were dropped. Do NOT reinterpret them.
sensitivity_readouts.validity_precondition: They are valid ONLY IF no component of the schedule is a function of the run's total length. Re-audited on the CURRENT bytes of run_dann_r5.py / dann_round5.py / da_losses.py / train_skeleton.py rather than inherited from 7.18 -- see schedule_audit below.
sensitivity_readouts.what_they_buy: budget-matched comparators against FreeMatch x nb3 (1500) and CORAL x nb3 (2000), which the 4000 headline does not provide

TOLERANCE_DISAGREEMENT_WITH_THE_BRIEF.declared_here: PASS/FAIL stays at the runner's CALIBRATED one-positive tolerance (1/98, and 1/97 on fold 4). The observed |diff| is reported separately and is expected to be 0.0, as arm 1 achieved.
TOLERANCE_DISAGREEMENT_WITH_THE_BRIEF.status: A DELIBERATE DEPARTURE FROM THE BRIEF, declared before any fold runs.
TOLERANCE_DISAGREEMENT_WITH_THE_BRIEF.why: Requiring exactly 0.0 at n_blocks=3 re-introduces the failure 7.7 documents: the eval runs through live_encode, whose SCORE drift against the cached path is ~1e-2. FreeMatch's nb3 gate demanded exact reproduction, passed folds 0/1/3 and FAILED fold 2 by exactly one positive after a correct 16-minute setup, because fold 2's closest positive sat 3.06e-03 above its threshold -- inside the drift envelope. The run was fine; the gate's premise was false. Round 5 achieving 0.0 is evidence the drift did not bite there, not evidence it cannot.

step0_gate.status: NON-SKIPPABLE. There is no flag that bypasses it.
step0_gate.why: The phase-1 head is fold-INDEPENDENT -- the same file initialises all five folds -- so a mis-pointed fold trains happily and produces a plausible wrong number. The gate is the only artifact proving fold identity, and the AUROC half is what actually proves it: it is rank-based and ~100x the resolution of the TPR half.

what_it_is: The unfrozen source-only baseline: encoder unfrozen at n_blocks=3, NO domain-adaptation term. It is round 5's ARM 1 extended from fold 0 to folds 1-4. lambda is pinned to 0.0 at every step, so the discriminator sits in the graph and contributes no gradient; what remains is supervised training on source with three encoder blocks unfrozen.

branches.outcome: folds 1-4 come in LOW (roughly consistent with fold 0's 0.1531, well below the DA arms)
branches.reading: unfreezing alone does nothing or slightly hurts, and the 0.15 -> 0.42 movement is attributable to the DA term. The paper's headline comparison becomes sound and 7.18's single-fold caveat is discharged.

branches.outcome: folds 1-4 come in NEAR THE DA ARMS (~0.40+)
branches.reading: the DA terms are decorative and the finding is about encoder capacity, not domain adaptation. A different paper, and still a publishable one -- write that one.

branches.bnm: NO-GO by default. Do not run BNM to break a tie that cannot be broken.
branches.outcome: IN BETWEEN, or the fold spread makes the call ambiguous

what_this_decides.note: Both branches are declared NOW so that neither can be chosen afterwards.
what_this_decides.on_landing: Update PROJECT.md's 'Next, in order' and 7.18's limitation note ('the effect size relative to unfreezing alone rests on a single fold') to say what the four folds actually showed.

why_it_exists: The three nb3 DA arms are all compared against FROZEN Baseline A at 0.176 while they themselves are unfrozen. Two things differ across that comparison -- the encoder went from frozen to unfrozen, AND a DA term was added -- so nothing in the current data attributes the 0.176 -> ~0.42 movement to either one. This run fills the missing cell.
